newsitem.title: EGYPT: Iran's third submarine passes through Suez Canal.
newsitem.headline: Iran's third submarine passes through Suez Canal.

text.p: A Russian-made submarine passed through the Suez Canal on Thursday on its way to join Iranian naval forces in the Gulf, shipping sources told Reuters.
The Kilo-class, diesel-powered submarine is the last of three submarines which Moscow has sold to Iran, the only Gulf state to deploy submarines in the oil-rich region.

Western diplomats have said the United States and Iran's Gulf Arab neighbours were closely watching to see when Iran would deploy the submarine, which can lay mines and shoot torpedoes in the world's largest oil-exporting shipping lane.
Washington and Iran's neighbours have voiced strong concerns over Iran's rearmament programme, which Tehran launched after its arsenal was depleted in the 1980-88 war with Iraq.
